subject: Post-call MAP: action items for recordkeeping, logs & PHI handling
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@medtechhealth.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call MAP: action items for recordkeeping, logs & PHI handling

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we all have the same MAP milestone on record. I’m attaching a MAP draft (v0.3) with inline milestone rows for data handling; please see the attachment reference below.

Summary of ask (from MedTech Health):
- Retention windows: patient billing records 7 years; aggregated telemetry/usage 2 years; detailed request-logs (for audit) configurable to 1–5 years — must confirm default.
- Auditability: ability to export time-ordered audit trails (who, what, where) in CSV/JSON for quarterly/internal audits.
- PHI constraints: PHI must be processed only in private deployment or dedicated tenancy; request for BAA and confirmation of encrypted-at-rest KMS handling.
- Access controls: role-based admin audit access and an immutable append-only log for compliance review.

MAP milestone (proposed):
- Title: Recordkeeping & Auditability — Retention, Logs, PHI Controls
- Target close date: 2026-09-30
- Redwood owner: Ben Carter (Sales Eng)
- Customer owner: Sara Lin (Security/Compliance)
- Dependencies: Legal sign-off on BAA, SOC2 artifact exchange, engineering config for retention export, Ops enable audit export endpoint

Immediate next steps (owner/action/date):
1) Redwood to upload MAP v0.3 with milestone rows + attachment: redwood-map-v0.3.xlsx (Priya) — by 2026-08-15
2) Security team to flag any missing artifacts in SOC2 checklist (Monica) — by 2026-08-18
3) MedTech to confirm required retention windows and whether PHI will be in scope (Sara) — by 2026-08-20
4) Schedule 30-min follow-up to confirm legal path for BAA & sample audit export format (Priya/Ben) — propose 2026-08-19

Attachments referenced: redwood-map-v0.3.xlsx (MAP with milestone rows), soc2-evidence-checklist.pdf (internal checklist).

Please reply with any edits; Sara — if you confirm the retention windows above (or call out adjustments), Ben will pick up engineering dependencies and propose the export format.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
---
Attachment stubs: redwood-map-v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB); soc2-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@medtechhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Nicholas Park <nicholas.park@cityclinic.org>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call MAP: action items for recordkeeping, logs & PHI handling

Priya — thanks for the clear summary. Couple clarifications from our side: we do need a BAA in place for any environment where PHI is processed (HIPAA). For the MAP milestone: PHI will only be in scope if we move forward with the private deployment option (we're evaluating dedicated vs private). For now assume PHI = conditional.

Retention specifics we need to confirm internally but preliminary guidance:
- Billing/patient records: statutory 7 years (confirmed)
- Audit logs (access & change logs): keep raw logs 3 years; index/summary 7 years (we perform compliance spot-checks)
- Telemetry usage: anonymized 2 years

Export format: we need a sample audit export (CSV or ndjson) with at minimum: timestamp (ISO8601), actor_id, action, resource_id, before/after (if applicable), request_id, and IP. Can you share a sample schema? Also please confirm encryption-in-transit and at-rest, and whether KMS keys can be customer-managed (CMK).

Legal needs to review the MAP & BAA; they’ve requested the current draft by 2026-08-18 so they can sign off by ~2026-09-10 if there are no major changes.

Short answers:
- We will confirm PHI scope by 2026-08-20.
- We approve the proposed target close date (2026-09-30) as realistic, pending legal and SOC2 artifacts.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up next week.

Best,
Sara Lin
Head of Security & Compliance | MedTech Health
sara.lin@medtechhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@medtechhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:22:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call MAP: action items for recordkeeping, logs & PHI handling

Priya / Monica — following up on internal alignment here and calling out owners + technical notes so we can close the MAP milestone by 2026-09-30 as discussed.

Internal owners & immediate actions:
- Security (Monica) — validate which SOC2 artifacts we can share; produce a minimal evidence pack and flag any gaps against MedTech checklist (by 2026-08-18).
- Engineering (Ben) — draft audit export schema (ndjson + CSV example), implement a retention-policy toggle in staging for log TTLs, and document KMS options (CMK vs Redwood-managed) (drafts by 2026-08-24).
- Ops (Priya) — coordinate a short demo of the audit export and retention UI for MedTech (target week of 2026-08-24).
- Legal (cc: Monica to loop) — start BAA template review once customer confirms PHI scope (aim to have BAA draft to customer by 2026-08-25).

Engineering notes (high-level):
- Audit export will include: timestamp, actor_id, action, resource_id, request_id, ip, before/after delta where available. Exports will be queryable and streamable to S3 with retention lifecycle policy.
- For PHI: private deployment will be our recommended approach; dedicated tenancy may be acceptable depending on contractual isolation and KMS controls.
- We can support customer-managed KMS but need to define entitlement model and rotation procedures.

Blocked items / dependencies:
- Customer to confirm PHI scope (Sara) — needed before we finalize BAA path.
- Legal approval windows — may impact timeline if additional CLAs are required.
- SOC2 evidence transfer — Monica to share checklist gaps.

I’ll prepare the draft export schema and a one-slide summary for the follow-up call. Priya — can you propose 3 slots on 2026-08-19 for a 30-min sync with Sara and Nicholas?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Thanks — that plan looks good. Two quick updates from our side:
1) Legal asked if you can highlight in the MAP draft which milestones explicitly require third-party contract changes (e.g., BAA) vs. configuration-only items. That will help prioritize their review.
2) We prefer the audit export to include request_id and a checksum/hash column to verify immutability (simple HMAC with per-file secret is acceptable).

We can make time for the 30-min sync on 2026-08-19; suggest 10:00 AM PT. Please send an invite. After our legal review (goal 2026-09-10), we’ll confirm PHI scope — if PHI is recorded in scope we will request a private deployment order.

Attached: sample export schema request (we’ll add comments directly to redwood-map-v0.3.xlsx).

Best,
Sara Lin
Head of Security & Compliance | MedTech Health
